sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF is a 9-billion-parameter causal language model with integrated vision encoding developed by unsloth. This GGUF quantization of Qwen3.5 uses Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 quantization, which achieves superior accuracy compared to other leading quantization methods.
